method.name: Haversine
method.description: Spherical shortest surface distance in meters. Coordinates interpreted as decimal longitude and latitude; no route, elevation or ellipsoid correction.

meta.unit: one original unique-address source-row pair; not a confirmed facility identity
limitations: Same address does not establish the same physical bin. Distances do not confirm relocation, removal or installation.
Coordinate changes can reflect precision, correction, geocoding or data-entry differences; causes require separate evidence.
Spherical distance is an approximation, not walking distance or surveyed movement. No datum transformation or field verification is performed.
The 2024 archive capture is Taipei 2024-10-19 (UTC 2024-10-18), not an original survey/update date. The 2026 source update is 2026-09-30; download 2026-10-15.
Both snapshots have unverified physical citywide completeness. Preserve source IDs, physical start lines, raw coordinates, dates, and original 75-pair membership.
